name: Hello World Service
blurb: The classical introductory exercise. Just create an HTTP service to say "Hello, World!".
instructions:
# Instructions

The classical introductory exercise but in an HTTP service.

## Objectives

- Modify the provided code so that it returns the string "Hello, World!".
- The service should respond to a GET HTTP request at the path "/greeting".
source: This is an exercise to introduce users to the Ballerina Service interface
